title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description: Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil. De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100). Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova. Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço. É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão. Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos: O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente. Atribuições O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar. 2-Técnico de Necropsia O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente. Atribuições O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil. As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais. As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias. Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos. O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso. Atribuições Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso. 5-Delegado de Polícia O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres: Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública; Assegurar a observância da lei; Defender as instituições públicas; Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais; Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais; Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital. Etapas do concurso A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital. O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social. Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo de Auxiliar de Necropsia da Polícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já para Técnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59. O Inspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38. A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95. Detalhes do concurso Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ) Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR). Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Nosso propósito é trazer impacto financeiro positivo para famílias e negócios. Regime presencial com flexibilidade. title: REMOTE - Senior Data Engineer (SQL DBA)
description: Job Description M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives. Primary DBA Responsibilities Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability. Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency. Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning. Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing. Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance. Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards. Team Responsibilities Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs. Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks. Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives. Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting. Qualifications Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery). Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams. Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives. Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail. AI and Automation Expectations Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality. Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation. Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification. Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability. Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data. Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability). Engagement Model This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need. We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership. Additional Information We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours. We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English. M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Especialista em Operações Comerciais
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) . No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de ESPECIALISTA EM OPERAÇÕES COMERCIAIS abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso: Sua missão Operar e otimizar o e-commerce (cadastro de produtos, preços e acompanhamento de pedidos). Acompanhar pedidos e garantir fluxo correto até a entrega ao cliente. Atuar junto à logística para melhorar prazos, custos e nível de serviço. Apoiar na contratação e gestão de transportadoras e fornecedores. Contribuir na organização do centro de distribuição e fluxo de pedidos. Aplicar políticas comerciais considerando impostos e benefícios fiscais. Planejar vendas e alinhar demanda com estoque. Gerenciar mix de produtos e giro de estoque. Definir e ajustar preços com base em margem, concorrência e conceitos de Revenue Management (precificação dinâmica). title: Gerente de manutenção
description: O Grupo Seres, em parceria com empresa Industria de Plásticos, seleciona profissional para atuar na função de Gerente de Manutenção Atividades: O Gerente de Manutenção na Indústria PET é o profissional responsável por planejar, gerenciar as atividades de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva dos equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Seu papel é garantir que todas as máquinas e sistemas estejam operando de forma eficiente e segura, contribuindo para a continuidade e a qualidade do processo produtivo. Principais Responsabilidades 1. Gestão da Equipe de Manutenção Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de manutenção, definindo funções, delegando atividades e garantindo que todos os membros da equipe desempenhem suas funções de forma eficiente. Realizar treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe de manutenção, promovendo a atualização técnica e a melhoria das habilidades operacionais. Monitorar o desempenho da equipe, realizar avaliações periódicas de desempenho e aplicar feedbacks para garantir a melhoria contínua do trabalho. 2. Planejamento e Execução de Manutenção Planejar e implementar o cronograma de manutenção preventiva e corretiva para todos os equipamentos da planta, minimizando paradas não programadas e otimizando a disponibilidade dos ativos. Garantir a execução eficaz das atividades de manutenção, como lubrificação, inspeção, ajustes e substituição de peças de equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Realizar análise crítica de falhas e implementar ações corretivas para evitar a recorrência de problemas operacionais. 3. Gestão de Recursos e Estoque Gerenciar o estoque de peças de reposição e materiais necessários para a manutenção, realizando compras, controle e acompanhamento de inventário de peças e componentes. Trabalhar junto ao setor de compras para garantir a aquisição de peças e materiais de qualidade, dentro dos prazos e com o melhor custo-benefício. Controlar os custos de manutenção, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros disponíveis, otimizando os gastos com peças, serviços e mão de obra. 4. Melhoria Contínua e Eficiência Operacional Gerir e analisar indicadores de desempenho de manutenção, como o tempo médio entre falhas (MTBF) e o tempo médio para reparo (MTTR), e propor melhorias nos processos. Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos de manutenção, utilizando ferramentas de gestão, como o PM (Planejamento de Manutenção) e o TPM (Manutenção Produtiva Total). Colaborar com outras áreas da produção para entender as necessidades específicas de cada linha e otimizar o uso dos equipamentos. 5. Gestão de Projetos e Inovações Tecnológicas Coordenar projetos de melhorias ou expansão de instalações, equipamentos e sistemas, implementando novas tecnologias ou modernizações nos processos de manutenção. Acompanhar a instalação de novos equipamentos e garantir que os processos de manutenção sejam adequados desde a fase de implantação. Implementar tecnologias de manutenção preditiva, como monitoramento remoto de equipamentos e análise de dados para identificar falhas antes que ocorram. 6. Segurança no Trabalho e Conformidade Regulatória Garantir que todos os procedimentos de manutenção sigam rigorosamente as normas de segurança do trabalho e as regulamentações ambientais aplicáveis. Promover a cultura de segurança, realizando treinamentos sobre o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e procedimentos de segurança. Realizar inspeções regulares nas instalações para garantir que todos os sistemas e equipamentos estejam operando dentro dos parâmetros de segurança e conformidade regulatória. 7. Análise de Desempenho e Relatórios Analisar relatórios de desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, fornecendo feedback para a equipe de manutenção e a gestão da fábrica. Preparar relatórios periódicos sobre o desempenho da manutenção, incluindo indicadores como custos, tempo de inatividade, e eficiência dos serviços prestados. Apresentar relatórios para a diretoria e outras áreas da empresa, propondo ações para resolver problemas de manutenção e melhorar a performance da planta. 8. Gestão de Contratos e Fornecedores Gerenciar contratos de serviços terceirizados relacionados à manutenção, como fornecedores de peças, consultorias ou serviços especializados. Negociar prazos, custos e condições com fornecedores, garantindo a qualidade e a entrega pontual dos serviços e materiais necessários para a manutenção da planta. Avaliar a performance dos fornecedores, garantindo que atendam aos padrões exigidos pela empresa. Profundo conhecimento em processos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, além de experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (como CMMS). Conhecimento em gestão de equipes, controle de custos e planejamento de manutenção. Familiaridade com as normas de segurança industrial, regulamentações ambientais e boas práticas de manutenção. Noções de controle de estoque e gestão de fornecedores. Habilidades Liderança e gestão de equipes, com foco em desenvolvimento, motivação e resultados. Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisões rápidas em situações de emergência. Habilidade em gestão de projetos, com foco na melhoria contínua dos processos. Excelente comunicação, tanto para reportar resultados para a direção quanto para interagir com as equipes de produção e outros departamentos. Habilidade para trabalhar com indicadores de desempenho e ferramentas de análise de dados. Características Pessoais Proatividade e visão estratégica, com foco em otimizar processos e reduzir custos. Forte senso de organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas atividades simultaneamente. Comprometimento com a segurança e qualidade em todas as etapas da manutenção. Espírito de liderança e habilidade para motivar a equipe a alcançar as metas estabelecidas. Requisitos Obrigatórios Formação superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou afins; Experiência sólida em gestão de manutenção em ambientes industriais, preferencialmente em indústrias de transformação plástica ou de produção em larga escala. title: Manager, Access Management Cluster
description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description: Senior Manager, Ceremonies Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Country Lead, Brazil
description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Events & Entertainment Location Brazil The Position The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end‑to‑end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision‑making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimise collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), Pre‑Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre‑production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high‑level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organise and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision‑maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue‑level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross‑functional planning forums and senior management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large‑scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team management, creative development, supplier management, and cross‑functional coordination. Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi‑supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies Administrative Skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments. Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. Organizational Skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. Problem‑Solving Skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. Interpersonal Skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. Cultural Sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. Passion for Entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. title: Consultor de Negócios (Ekotruck)
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR) . No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. description: Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. Você coordena com a equipe para resolver desafios operacionais para encantar o cliente Amazon. Seu principal contato é o parceiro AMXL, cuja performance você melhora diretamente através de planos de ações consolidados. description: The Activation Manager role represents a strategic transformation in how Zamora Company approaches the market. Moving beyond traditional brand advocacy, this position serves as a strategic partner to both On-Trade and Off-Trade channels, with a clear focus on driving sell-out, ensuring flawless execution of our brands across all touchpoints, and delivering measurable return on investment in the Rio region. With a strong entrepreneurial mindset, this individual will spend the majority of their time in-market, working hands‑on to elevate execution. They will lead the adoption of the AVQPAP model (Availability, Visibility, Quality, Price, Activation, Promotion) to bring the Picture of Success to life. Partnering closely with distributor sales teams and key customers, they will identify opportunities, close executional gaps, and build long‑term, value‑driven relationships across São Paulo and the broader Southeast region. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Field Execution & Market Presence Be present in the market on a daily basis, visiting On Trade, Off Trade and Key Accounts, ensuring the correct execution of Zamora’s brands. Accompany the distributor's team in top accounts to guarantee strategic alignment. Monitor and master the AVQPAP execution standards (Availability, Visibility, Quality of Display, Price, Activation, Promotion) across the territory. Identify execution gaps and immediately work with distributors and outlets to correct them. Ensure all points of sale are aligned with Zamora’s brand positioning and premium image. Distributor & Sales Team Development Work hand in hand with distributor sales teams, acting as a field coach and execution driver to generate sell out. Support sales reps during visits, helping them to sell, place, activate and upgrade Zamora brands. Train distributor and customers’ sales forces on ZC Brands (brand building and story‑selling) Trade Marketing & Activation Design and execute point‑of‑sale activation plans tailored to Rio’s On & Off Trade reality. Implement national and regional brand programs in the field, ensuring perfect execution at store level. Lead tastings, bartender activations, menu placements, cocktail programs and in‑store promotions. Be responsible for the quality of execution of key platforms like L43 Puro, Carajillo and Limão. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Detection Act as Zamora’s market radar in Rio. Identify trends, new hot spots, key bartenders, emerging venues and new retail opportunities. Monitor competitors’ activities, pricing, promotions and visibility. Provide regular feedback to the Area Director and Marketing Team with actionable insights. Relationship Building Build strong and trusted relationships with: Distributor management and sales teams Bartenders, bar managers, store owners and buyers Key influencers Become a recognized Zamora representative in the Rio trade. Develop mid- and long‑term partnerships that secure Zamora’s presence in priority accounts. Reporting & Performance Tracking KPIs will be measured in 4 pillars: Business (eg. volume sold on On trade Channel) Commercial Execution (# stores with perfect execution) Promotion (eg, number of trainings) Digital (Eg. reports/ community built) Provide structured reports with photos, insights and recommendations. Help to ensure activities and investments are properly documented and evaluated. REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Brand Activation, Sales or Brand Ambassador roles, ideally in the alcoholic beverages industry. Having worked with distributors is a plus Deep understanding of On-Trade and Off-Trade dynamics in Rio, with a strong “in‑market” mindset and passion for being close to the consumer (bars, restaurants, clubs, and retail). Good understanding of On Trade & Off Trade dynamics in Rio. Strong ability to execute and drive others to execute. Proven ability to execute with excellence and influence others to deliver against high standards in the field. Strong relationship‑building skills, with the ability to engage and partner effectively with distributor sales teams, bartenders, and retail customers. Analytical and action‑oriented mindset, capable of translating field insights into clear, impactful actions. Highly organized, disciplined, and results‑driven, with strong attention to execution quality. Naturally curious and connected to cultural trends (music, nightlife, gastronomy, fashion), with the ability to anticipate emerging opportunities in the market. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus. Willingness to travel extensively within São Paulo state and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends. This role is a key pillar in Zamora’s ambition to build a best‑in‑class execution model in Brazil—ensuring our brands are visible, desired, and flawlessly brought to life at every relevant point of sale in Rio. title: Intern Product Development Engineering
description: The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs. Collect and analyze customer feedback to continuously enhance the user experience Work closely with designers, developers, and other team members to ensure consistency in user experience across all products Assist in creating documentation, guides, training materials and development specifications Engage in data entry activities, metrics analysis and reporting on individual KPIs to internal customers Assist in Quality Assurance related activities, with focus on the on-time delivery of system releases Contribute innovative ideas and solutions to enhance the digital experience COMPETENCIES Strong attention to detail and analytical skills Ability to adapt to dynamic work environments Collaborative spirit and ability to work collaboratively as part of a team English (Fluent language for conversation, reading, and writing) QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Attending OR achieved degree in Business Administration, Design, Marketing, Computer Science, or related areas Some prior contact with Agile Methodology is desirable Intermediate knowledge on Microsoft Office 365 Tools Basic knowledge of UX/UI principles and a willingness to learn and deepen expertise in this area Exposure and deep interest in AI platforms used for rapid prototyping and assisted-development, such as Claude Code, ChatGPT CODEX, Lovable, Google Gemini, or similar is a plus Knowledge of design tools such as Figma, Canva, Miro, or similar is a plus OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS PROPOSED ONBOARDING PLAN (subject to change) First 15 Days: Orientation and Integration: Get to know the Cx team, PD colleagues, and internal processes. Initial Training: Familiarize with tools like SMP, FIGMA, MIRO, CANVA, and more. Basic UX/UI Knowledge: Learn fundamental methodologies. Contextual Research: Explore SMP products and project roadmaps. Review Past Designs: Analyze prior UX/UI projects. Assist with Minor Tasks: Support the team with smaller assignments. First 30 Days: Master Design Tools: Gain further proficiency in Canva, Figma, Miro, Azure DevOps. Journey Projects: Work on a supervised customer journey project, focusing on UI updates. Attend Team Meetings: Join discussions on ongoing projects and contribute ideas. User Feedback: Learn to collect and analyze user input for product enhancements. First 60 Days: Mid-Term Project: Present outcomes of the journey project, showcasing new user flows. User Testing: Participate in organizing and conducting user tests (Focus Groups). First 90 Days: Design Documentation: Collaborate on style guides and design specs. Story Creation and Review: Finalize Stories and Epics. Results Presentation: Share project results and improvements. Innovative Ideas: Continue contributing innovative concepts. Performance Evaluation: Discuss progress and set future goals in a performance evaluation with the supervisor.
